df57423f23205af9.company_name: مؤسسة خالد عوض عويض الحمدي التجارية
df57423f23205af9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وادي الضيافة لخدمات الإعاشة عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة، وضمان سير العمليات المالية بسلاسة وفعالية. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهي بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية كل وردية عمل، مع التأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات النقدية أو عن طريق بطاقات الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات اللازمة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند الضرورة. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بمهنية وتلبية طلباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات المالية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل في التعامل مع المبالغ النقدية. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. مهارات التعامل مع أنظمة نقاط البيع (POS). القدرة على حل المشكلات البسيطة المتعلقة بالمدفوعات. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة وادي الضيافة لخدمات الإعاشة في الدمام. بيئة العمل ديناميكية وتتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء والزملاء. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل في شركة متخصصة في خدمات الإعاشة. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

df432a333a723786.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة الفارسي المطورة للمقاولات العامة عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تشغيل وقيادة المعدات الثقيلة المستخدمة في أعمال الإزالة والهدم ورفع المخلفات ضمن مواقع العمل، مع الالتزام التام بإجراءات السلامة والمساهمة في إنجاز الأعمال الميدانية بكفاءة ودقة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة المعدات الثقيلة المختلفة المستخدمة في أعمال الإزالة والهدم ورفع المخلفات. التقيد بمسارات العمل الموضوعة للمعدات وفق خطط العمل المتبعة. إجراء فحوصات دورية على المعدات قبل التشغيل لضمان جاهزيتها وسلامتها. إبلاغ فرق الصيانة فوراً في حال اكتشاف أي أعطال أو مشاكل فنية بالمعدات. الالتزام التام بأدلة الإجراءات وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير المعتمدة. التقيد بسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة في جميع الأوقات لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المساهمة في إنجاز الأعمال الميدانية بكفاءة ودقة وفق الجدول الزمني المحدد للمشروع. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال قيادة وتشغيل المعدات الثقيلة أو ما شابهها. القدرة على تشغيل وقيادة أنواع مختلفة من المعدات الثقيلة. فهم جيد لإجراءات السلامة المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات الثقيلة. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بالدقة والكفاءة في إنجاز المهام الموكلة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة عمل ميدانية. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل في مواقع المشاريع بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية ومعايير السلامة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مجموعة الفارسي المطورة للمقاولات العامة.

The role requires 4-6 years of relevant experience. Role Overview As a Structural Design Engineer, you will be a key member of the engineering department, responsible for developing and optimizing structural designs. This includes ensuring compliance with building codes and collaborating with other disciplines to deliver integrated project solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop structural designs and calculations for a range of projects, including residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. Utilize advanced structural engineering software to create accurate and efficient designs. Analyze structural systems to ensure compliance with local building codes and standards. Collaborate with architects, contractors, and other engineering disciplines to optimize designs. Prepare technical reports, specifications, and design drawings. Conduct site visits to assess existing structures and monitor construction progress. Participate in project meetings and provide technical expertise to clients and team members. Stay updated on the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices in structural engineering. Qualifications and Experience 4-6 years of experience in structural design engineering. Demonstrated ability to design and analyze various structural systems. Proficiency in advanced structural engineering software. Strong understanding of local building codes and standards. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a collaborative engineering environment. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

dfa2ab6e9cb6164c.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Senior Project Manager to oversee and manage the successful delivery of a major mega infrastructure and landscape development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading multidisciplinary project teams and coordinating with various stakeholders to ensure project objectives are met in line with approved scope, quality standards, contractual obligations, budget, and schedule requirements. Project Leadership and Management The Senior Project Manager will provide leadership across all phases of project delivery, from planning and design management to procurement support, construction supervision, commissioning, and handover. The position requires strong program management capabilities, effective stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to manage complex project interfaces while ensuring compliance with local regulations, safety requirements, sustainability objectives, and industry best practices throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage all project management activities from initiation through design, construction, commissioning, and handover. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across infrastructure, transportation, utilities, public realm, landscape, and associated development packages. Ensure project delivery aligns with approved scope, program, budget, quality standards, and client expectations. Manage consultant and contractor performance against contractual obligations, project milestones, and key performance indicators. Review and monitor project deliverables, reports, schedules, risk registers, and technical submissions. Coordinate project interfaces between design, construction, commercial, planning, and stakeholder management teams. Facilitate project meetings with clients, consultants, contractors, government authorities, utility providers, and stakeholders. Monitor project risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impacts on quality, cost, schedule, and project performance. Review and evaluate variations, claims, change requests, and commercial matters, providing recommendations. Track project KPIs, progress reports, cost reports, and project performance metrics for management and client review. Support procurement activities including consultant appointments, tender evaluations, contractor assessments, and package awards. Drive resolution of project-related technical, commercial, and operational issues affecting program delivery. Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, sustainability, and quality management requirements. Monitor project controls functions including planning, scheduling, cost management, change management, and risk management. Lead, mentor, and supervise project engineers, package managers, and multidisciplinary project teams. Support senior leadership in project reporting, governance reviews, client presentations, and strategic decision-making processes. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project management, specifically within infrastructure and landscape development projects. Demonstrated experience in leading multidisciplinary teams and managing complex project interfaces. Proven ability to manage projects from initiation through to handover, ensuring adherence to scope, budget, and schedule. About AtkinsRéalis AtkinsRéalis is a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. The company connects people, data, and technology to transform global infrastructure and energy systems. Working with industry partners and clients, and a global team of consultants, designers, engineers, and project managers, AtkinsRéalis is committed to engineering a better future for the planet and its people.

dfb687c5976dfc27.description: About the Role Skilled Careers is seeking a Lead Estimator to join a leading EPC and main contractor in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves heading the estimating function for high-value data centre, pharmaceutical, and biopharma projects across the region. The role requires leading the complete estimating process, from early cost planning through to tender submission, and managing a small team of estimators. Key Responsibilities Lead the preparation of detailed estimates and tender submissions for EPC and design-and-build projects. Produce cost plans, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and pricing across civil, structural, MEP, and process packages. Review tender documents, drawings, and specifications, identifying risks, opportunities, and value-engineering options. Manage subcontractor and supplier enquiries, followed by analysis and leveling of quotations. Collaborate with engineering, procurement, planning, and commercial teams to develop bid strategies. Present estimates and commercial positions to senior management. Build and maintain cost databases and benchmarking for mission-critical and life sciences projects. Mentor and develop junior estimators within the team. Qualifications and Experience A degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering is preferred; Quantity Surveying or related degrees will be considered. A minimum of 10 years of estimating experience, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior role. Background with an EPC, main contractor, or cost consultancy is required. Essential estimating experience on data centre, pharmaceutical, or biopharma projects. Strong knowledge of MEP and process systems, including HVAC, cleanrooms, critical power, and cooling. Experience pricing large, complex projects, ideally exceeding USD 100 million. Experience in the GCC or KSA region is an advantage. Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Experience with estimating software such as CostX or Candy is an advantage. Additional Requirements Excellent communication and presentation skills are essential for this role. Compensation This position offers a competitive tax-free salary.

dfc05b8d509f4402.description: About the Role National Guard Health Affairs (NGHA) is seeking a Laboratory Technician for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role involves performing essential laboratory duties in accordance with established procedures and the highest standards to ensure patient care and safety. Key Responsibilities Greet patients courteously and respond with empathy and positive interpersonal skills. Draw blood accurately following established laboratory procedures, including proper patient identification, test verification, tube selection, dating, timing, and labeling. Maintain blood drawing trays to ensure they are neat, disinfected, and well-supplied. Process all laboratory test requisitions and specimens efficiently and appropriately, adhering to the highest standards. Monitor timed specimen collection and their importance, collecting these specimens at appropriate times. Collect laboratory blood specimens from various hospital areas or receive specimens via pneumatic tube or other transportation systems. Accurately log and track all incoming laboratory specimens into the system. Sort laboratory specimens according to labels and distribute them to assigned sections. Prepare laboratory specimens for sending to reference laboratories. Prepare and submit reports (Safety Report System) for wrong labeling and escalate issues to the immediate supervisor. Adhere to strict policies and procedures while treating patients with care, and follow strict safety precautions to prevent the transmission of infectious diseases. Perform duties in accordance with the Saudi Central Board for Accreditation of Healthcare Institutions (CBAHI), Joint Commission International Accreditation (JCIA), College of American Pathologist (CAP), and MNGHA Laboratory policies and safety standards. Perform other job-related duties as assigned. Work Environment Work is performed independently, with regular review for accuracy. The role involves routine work with perpetual interaction with relevant stakeholders. The technician is required to provide coverage during emergencies, disasters, and other unplanned occasions. This position may require working overtime, night shifts, weekends, and holidays. Adherence to safe practices related to Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) and operating in a safe manner to reduce the risk of injuries is mandatory.

dfdda1144beaa7a4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الإتجاهات السبعة للمقاولات العامة عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الظهران. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإدارة برامج الصيانة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بشبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإدارة عمليات الصيانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة الإتجاهات السبعة للمقاولات العامة في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو المهني. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة الإتجاهات السبعة للمقاولات العامة.

dfe68487e9e8246b.description: About Salla Salla is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer - PayLink to join their team. This is a full-time position focused on designing and building payment-critical backend services. The role requires a strong commitment to correctness, reliability, and security within a modern Java stack. Role Overview The Senior Backend Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end development of payment-critical backend services. This involves working with a modern Java stack and ensuring high standards for system correctness, reliability, and security. The position also includes mentoring mid-level engineers. Key Responsibilities Design and build payment-critical backend services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot. Ensure the correctness and reliability of systems under various load conditions. Develop robust integrations and event-driven workflows. Write comprehensive tests and contribute to maintaining high engineering standards. Provide mentorship to mid-level engineers. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 5 years of experience in Java backend development with Spring Boot. Hands-on experience in payments or fintech, specifically having worked on real payment or financial-transaction systems. Practical experience with at least one payment processor or gateway (*, MPGS, Cybersource, or mada). This is a mandatory requirement. Strong understanding of microservices architecture and REST API design, as well as relational databases. Solid grasp of transactional integrity and system reliability. Experience with containers, CI/CD pipelines, and robust automated testing practices. Proficiency in AI-augmented engineering, actively utilizing AI coding tools such as Claude Code in daily development. This is a mandatory requirement. Preferred Skills Experience with multiple payment processors or gateways. Familiarity with cloud platforms (OCI, AWS, or Azure) and Kafka. Work Type This is a full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

dffea76a830f5763.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise known for innovation in planning, design, and project delivery across built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant global projects and is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and a Top 20 International PM/CM Firm. World Architecture ranks KEO as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. The Role: Document Controller KEO Group is seeking a Document Controller to join its Design team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the effective management, control, and distribution of project and design documentation for multidisciplinary teams. The Document Controller will maintain accurate document registers, coordinate design submissions, and ensure that the latest approved information is accessible to project stakeholders. Experience with EDMS platforms such as Deltek, Aconex, Autodesk BIM 360, Oracle Unifier, or PMWeb is essential for success in this position. Key Responsibilities Manage and maintain project documentation in accordance with established procedures and project requirements. Control the receipt, registration, distribution, and filing of multidisciplinary design documents, drawings, specifications, reports, and correspondence. Maintain accurate drawing registers, document registers, transmittals, and submission trackers. Ensure appropriate revision and version control to guarantee project teams work with the latest approved documentation. Coordinate document workflows among Architecture, Structural, MEP, and other design disciplines, as well as Project and Design Managers. Prepare, issue, and track document transmittals and design submissions to clients, consultants, and other stakeholders. Monitor outstanding reviews, approvals, and document status, following up with design teams to meet submission deadlines. Perform quality checks on documents before formal issue, including verifying document numbers, revision status, naming conventions, formatting, and required approvals. Upload, distribute, and maintain documentation through the applicable Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) or Common Data Environment. Support the Design team by efficiently retrieving drawings, reports, and correspondence when needed. Maintain structured electronic filing and archiving systems to ensure document security, traceability, and retrievability. Ensure superseded documentation is clearly identified and archived to prevent unintended use. Support internal reviews and audits by ensuring document-control records are complete, accurate, and readily available. Liaise with internal teams and external stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and document-control issues. Maintain confidentiality and appropriate access controls for sensitive project information. Support continuous improvement of document-control processes and workflows. Qualifications and Experience A Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Engineering Administration, Document Control, or a related discipline. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant Document Control experience, preferably within an architectural, engineering, or multidisciplinary design consultancy. Demonstrable experience supporting design teams and design deliverables within the architecture, engineering, or construction industry. Strong understanding of document numbering, revision control, transmittals, document registers, workflows, and archiving. Experience working with an EDMS/CDE, preferably platforms such as Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360, SharePoint, or PMWeb. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook. Experience controlling drawings and deliverables across multiple design disciplines. Required Skills Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain a high level of accuracy while managing a significant volume of documentation. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with Design Managers, architects, engineers, BIM teams, and other project stakeholders. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team environment.

df76dd3eea338ccf.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Specialist - Procurement to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role is essential for ensuring efficient and competitive sourcing of goods and services, aligning with organizational policies. Role Overview The Specialist - Procurement will support end-to-end procurement activities. This involves managing procurement transactions, sourcing activities, and supplier coordination, while also focusing on documentation, cost optimization, and compliance. The role requires 2-5 years of experience in procurement. Key Responsibilities Manage assigned procurement activities from purchase requisition through sourcing, evaluation, award, and purchase order issuance. Conduct RFQs, RFPs, and competitive tendering in accordance with procurement policies and approved authority levels. Support the development of sourcing strategies and identify opportunities for cost savings, supplier consolidation, and improved commercial terms. Perform commercial evaluations of supplier proposals, including pricing, payment terms, lead times, and contractual requirements. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to clarify requirements, specifications, scope of work, budgets, and delivery timelines. Negotiate with suppliers to achieve competitive pricing and favorable commercial terms. Prepare procurement documentation, bid comparisons, evaluation summaries, recommendations for award, and required approvals. Support supplier onboarding, qualification, and ongoing supplier performance management. Maintain accurate procurement records and ensure transactions comply with procurement policies, delegation of authority, and audit requirements. Monitor purchase orders and supplier commitments to ensure timely delivery and resolve procurement-related issues. Maintain procurement data and contribute to reporting on spend, savings, procurement cycle time, supplier performance, and compliance. Develop productive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders while maintaining procurement ethics and confidentiality. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in procurement or a related field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the successful candidate will work collaboratively with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to achieve procurement objectives.

df5481d77ea39594.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المسار الحديث للمقاولات عن مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في احد رفيده، بمنطقة عسير. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان الالتزام بالمعايير. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية التصميم الشاملة للمشاريع وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة البيئية. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال صيانة المعدات وتصليحها بهدف تقليل العادم والمخلفات، والتأكد من توافق العمليات مع معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. مراقبة العمليات وإجراء جولات تفتيشية منتظمة لمواقع التشغيل والعمليات لضمان الالتزام بمعايير سلامة البيئة، وتقديم النصح والمشورة اللازمة في هذا الصدد. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة أو مجال هندسي ذي صلة. القدرة على دراسة وتطوير معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لمراقبة وتقييم العمليات. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة المسار الحديث للمقاولات، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة احد رفيده. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على تقديم المشورة الفنية في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. مهارات ممتازة في المراقبة والتفتيش. القدرة على تطوير الإجراءات ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. مهارات إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

df826839ee492c81.description: About KBR and the Project KBR, Inc. is providing PMO services, enterprise-level governance, assurance, integration, and performance oversight for a major infrastructure program in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This project involves a mixed-use development designed to be a global landmark and an authentic destination. The community will function as a distinct, self-sustaining hub within Riyadh, featuring several iconic assets. The Role of Project Control Manager The Project Control Manager, reporting to the Project Controls Director, is responsible for maintaining, governing, implementing, and providing pre and post-contract implementation governance for the suite of Project Controls policies, management plans, standards, procedures, and processes. This role supports reporting requirements and systems such as Aconex, Unifier, and P6. The Project Control Manager is also required to perform regular reviews and updates of existing governance documents on a quarterly or annual basis. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Onboard and train PMCs to facilitate understanding of the program, policies, processes, and associated project management information systems and applications. Maintain, implement, and administer the PMC onboarding process and welcome pack documents, continuously updating the PMC onboarding tracker. Maintain and implement the Project Controls governance structure, including roles and responsibilities (RACI) across all downstream levels. Review existing structures, propose improvements, and align with required updates/changes. Maintain, review, and update all Reporting Governance Documents, including management plans, manuals, guidelines, and templates. Develop, implement, and administer a comprehensive program meeting and reporting calendar for assigned Districts/Master Plans. Manage and maintain the PMIS-driven business intelligence (BI) reporting platform, including preparing and creating new BI dashboards and data entry registers through approved systems (*, SharePoint, Unifier). Compile data from PMCs for standardized weekly, monthly, and executive-level dashboards. Perform project-level performance reporting for schedule, cost, risk, procurement, OHSE, and change management. Ensure consistent data definitions, KPIs, and red-amber-green (RAG) criteria across all reports. Assist with the preparation of training material for PMCs on the use of implemented systems and data population. Provide support to the client's Project Controls Team for related PMIS and Data Warehouse (DWH) requirements. Maintain, implement, and administer a process for tracking and monitoring PMC performance against agreed KPIs, producing a monthly report highlighting performance and required corrective actions. Update the status of corrective actions during subsequent reporting cycles. Assess existing monitoring systems and propose enhancements and improvements to the overall process. Ensure PMC reporting schedules are consistent with PMO preparation of executive reports. Review and collate District/Master Plan programs to produce and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS). Establish and implement Project Controls Compliance Audit Requirements and conduct regular PMC audits to ensure adherence to standards and policies. Implement processes and systems to monitor the timely completion of Stage Gate Reviews and reporting across assigned Districts/Master Plans, highlighting issues and/or risks impacting program delivery. Maintain and issue the "KPI's Report" monthly, highlighting key areas of concern with corrective measures and mitigation. Produce a "Key Actions Required" report and escalation process to ensure all required actions are presented to executive management for escalation and action plans. Prepare the monthly Programme Status Report highlighting overall program, district, and individual project status and progress, including status against approved dates, schedule alerts, and key issues. Manage and update the existing Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) with updates recorded in the WBS change register. Maintain an updated mapping tracker between WBS, CBS, and SAP projects. Prepare monthly Programme Level Status Reports highlighting overall program, District, and individual project status and progress. Prepare required inputs for Executive Reports, including program and commercial update information and program "asks" requirements from client-collated information. Develop and implement a Value Engineering Management plan, process, and templates with communication and training provided to PMCs to record savings against the Budget (Total Development Cost). Develop and maintain a standardized Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) across all programs and projects to ensure consistent cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting, with alignment between CBS, WBS, work packages, procurement strategies, and budgeting requirements. Develop and maintain a structured Work Package Identification framework to ensure all project scope is clearly defined, consistently structured, and effectively aligned with planning, cost, procurement, and delivery. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project control management or a related field. Demonstrated experience with Project Controls policies, management plans, standards, procedures, and processes. Proficiency with project management information systems and applications such as Aconex, Unifier, and P6. Experience in PMO services, enterprise-level governance, assurance, integration, and performance oversight. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working within a dynamic team supporting a significant infrastructure program.

dfd7a72887d22b46.description: About WorleyParsons Worley is an Australian-headquartered global company specializing in energy, chemicals, and resources. The company partners with customers to deliver projects and create value across the lifecycle of their assets, offering expertise in consulting, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, and decommissioning. Worley leverages extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery to support customers in navigating complexity, meeting current needs, and transitioning to more sustainable solutions. The company is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace, encouraging applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Provide technical direction and guidance to engineers and designers. Review and approve engineering calculations, studies, specifications, and equipment selections. Lead design reviews, technical audits, peer reviews, and engineering assurance activities. Mentor and develop discipline engineers and technical specialists. Project Management Contributions Manage discipline scope, schedule, cost, quality, and resource requirements. Support project planning, forecasting, progress reporting, and change management activities. Ensure engineering deliverables are completed within project milestones. Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies. Drive the achievement of project objectives and client expectations. Application Information This is a full-time position located in Al Khobar. Salary details will be disclosed during the application process.

dfc9a9712d038f4f.description: About the Role The Luxury Collection is seeking a Life Guard to join their team in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring the safety of swimmers and maintaining the pool area, contributing to a secure and enjoyable environment for guests. Key Responsibilities Apply appropriate rescue techniques when swimmers require assistance. Monitor the swimming area for dangerous conditions, unusual activities, and struggling swimmers. Enforce the rules and regulations of the recreation facility. Identify situations where guests may not be able to safely participate in an activity and inform management. Provide initial assistance to injured guests until emergency medical services arrive. Contribute to a fun and relaxing atmosphere for guests. Manage towels by obtaining, folding, and stacking them according to company procedures. Clean the pool deck through washing, mopping, and general cleaning tasks. Operational Duties and Compliance Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to the manager. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Adhere to company policies and procedures, including maintaining confidentiality of proprietary information and protecting company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests in accordance with company standards. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs, including assisting individuals with disabilities. Communicate with others using clear and professional language. Support co-workers and treat them with dignity and respect. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines to identify defects. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations, including running, walking, or jogging. Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance, and objects exceeding 75 pounds with assistance.
